query: SELECT r.kind AS "kind!", h.id AS "unit_id!: _", h.project_id AS "project_id!: _", p.slug AS "project_slug!", h.number AS "number!", h.title AS "title!", h.state AS "state!" FROM unit_relations r JOIN units h ON h.id=r.unit_id JOIN projects p ON p.id=h.project_id WHERE r.target_id=$1 UNION SELECT 'mention' AS "kind!", h.id AS "unit_id!: _", h.project_id AS "project_id!: _", p.slug AS "project_slug!", h.number AS "number!", h.title AS "title!", h.state AS "state!" FROM mentions m JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.source_id AS unit_id WHERE m.source_type='unit' UNION ALL SELECT c.unit_id FROM comments c WHERE m.source_type='comment' AND c.id=m.source_id UNION ALL SELECT a.unit_id FROM phase_outputs e JOIN attempts a ON a.id=e.attempt_id WHERE m.source_type='report' AND e.id=m.source_id) s ON true JOIN units h ON h.id=s.unit_id JOIN projects p ON p.id=h.project_id WHERE m.target_id=$1 AND h.id<>$1 ORDER BY 1,4,5
